fusions.name: Parting Waft
fusions.desc: Releases a foul cloud that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stink Bomb
fusions.desc: Throws a sealed pouch that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Nobody Follows
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Fair Warning
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
